tail:
**Batch 57 is complete.** Both pages and their manifests are populated with five A-page items and two examples. I added the local \(g^{(2)}(0)\) definition needed by the single-photon example. All seven Step 1 records are current and `ready`; they document authoring readiness, not independent proof approval.

The arguments and scope notes are in [batch notes](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-57.notes.md). The [proof contracts](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-57.proof-contracts.json), [coverage](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-57.coverage.json), and [cross-batch dependencies](/home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/physics/research/physics-non-fluid-129-2026-10-21-r2-batch-57.cross-batch-dependencies.json) are complete. Source records cover full-text readings of [Navarrete-Benlloch](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2203.13206), [Weedbrook et al.](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1110.3234), and [Watrous, Chapter 2](https://cs.uwaterloo.ca/~watrous/TQI/TQI.2.pdf).

Scoped checks passed: proof layout (7 items, 23 steps), precheck, strict proof contracts, content policy, dependency closure, forward references, rendering, source fetch (5/5), and coverage (21 results). All seven dependency levels match the run graph: 5, 6, 6, 6, 7, 7, 7.

The run-wide checks still encounter unrelated unfinished manifests: the item-level check reports 30 errors elsewhere, and the batch-level check stops on four bare-string entries in batch 77. I left those manifests and the owner-controlled schedule unchanged.
